title: vitex variifolia
intro: Vitex variifolia, commonly known as the Chinese chaste tree, is a species of flowering plant in the family Lamiaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Vitex variifolia include its ability to regulate the menstrual cycle, alleviate menopausal symptoms, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of Vitex variifolia include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
